scenes.script: Rahul says: Jab bhi English bolne ki baat aati thi, main freeze ho jata tha. Mistake karne se bahut darr lagta tha.
scenes.on_screen_text: English bolne se darr lagta hai? Mistakes hone ka tension hai?

scenes.script:
Rahul says: Phir mujhe Supernova AI mila. Meri AI teacher, Miss Nova, mera level analyze karti hain aur mere liye ek personalized plan banati hain.
Rahul says: Aur sabse acchi baat, main private me practice kar sakta hoon. Koi dekh nahi raha hota, aur wo meri mistakes ko kabhi judge nahi kartiin.
scenes.on_screen_text: Miliye Supernova AI se! Apni personal AI teacher ke saath kabhi bhi practice karein.

scenes.script: Rahul says: Ab main sirf textbooks nahi padhta. Main actually zor se bolkar practice karta hoon, Miss Nova aur Priya jaise doosre learners ke saath.
scenes.on_screen_text: Zor se boliye aur supportive community ke saath practice karein!

scenes.script:
Rahul says: Hum real-life situations ki practice karte hain, jaise Mumbai me mera upcoming job interview.
Rahul says: Daily practice se, mere confidence me ek clear improvement dikhne laga hai.
scenes.on_screen_text: Job interviews jaise real-life scenarios practice karein. Aaj hi shuru karein!

scenes.script: Rahul says: Ghanto scrolling karke time waste karna band karo. Supernova AI ko din me bas 15 minutes do. App download karo aur bolna shuru karo!
scenes.on_screen_text: Bas 15 minutes roz. Aaj hi Supernova AI download karein!
